title: Write AI prompt template in src/lib/feature/prompts.ts
description: Create the prompt builder for the feature spec generation. The prompt instructs the AI to output ONLY a JSON object with spec and tasks fields. Includes few-shot examples.
acceptanceCriteria: Returned string contains JSON output format instructions
Prompt includes few-shot examples of the expected output format

steps.details: Create the file. Define the few-shot example as a constant showing the expected JSON output format.

technicalNotes: The EXAMPLE_OUTPUT shows the AI exactly what format to return — few-shot examples significantly improve JSON compliance
